intro: Menethil Keep is the stone stronghold dominating the skyline of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Marked by four sturdy watchtowers, it serves as the administrative heart and defensive bastion of the Alliance port, housing the local militia commander, Captain Stoutfist.

p: Rising above the wooden docks and soggy marshes of the Wetlands, Menethil Keep is the central military strongpoint of Menethil Harbor. With four stone watchtowers gazing out over the town and the bay, the fortress offers a commanding view against seaward raiders, renegades, and the encroaching swamp beasts. Inside, Captain Stoutfist oversees the defense of the port, directing the town militia and organizing patrols to safeguard Alliance interests throughout the region.
